evidence_quotes.O: On David Beagles classic guitar solo "Joy", it was as if he was in the room with me, I could hear every pick and pluck of every string.
evidence_quotes.C: I was about to give up when I was directed to a firmware update for my DVD drive. Once I flashed the drive, not a single bad disk has been wasted!
evidence_quotes.E: I piped it into my receiver and hit the power button and bingo! it found my network over it's installed handy dandy wireless network adapter (G).
evidence_quotes.A: Must've just gotten a bad one...: My experience with this player was not very positive.
evidence_quotes.N: However, if I decide to go upstairs then I have issues with the walls, interference etc. But I knew that was going to happen
